summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release (Release Number CB22-156) on New Residential Construction for August 2022, issued September 20, 2022. Relevant to the task: Table 1a provides seasonally adjusted annual rates for total privately-owned housing units authorized by building permits, disaggregated by region (Northeast, Midwest, South, West) for August 2022 and the preceding July 2022. It explicitly lists the month-over-month percent change for August 2022 compared to July 2022 for each region, supplying the initial data point within the 2022/08–2025/05 window. However, the data is preliminary ("p"), the report covers only the beginning of the required timeframe, and later reports in the collection will prevail under the "most recent report shall prevail" rule.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release detailing new residential construction for September 2022. Relevant to the task: Table 1a provides seasonally adjusted annual rates for new private housing units authorized (building permits) broken down by region (Northeast, Midwest, South, West). Provides month-over-month percent changes for total permits from August to September 2022, including revised figures for August. This report contributes the initial data points for the August 2022 to September 2022 period but does not contain data extending to May 2025 required to calculate the full average growth rate.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release on New Residential Construction for October 2022 (released November 17, 2022). Relevant to the task, Table 1a provides seasonally adjusted annual rates for total private housing units authorized by building permits, disaggregated by region (Northeast, Midwest, South, West). The table includes monthly data from August 2022 through October 2022, supplying the initial segment of the required 2022/08–2025/05 timeframe. While it allows for the calculation of month-over-month growth rates for late 2022, the report lacks data for 2023 through May 2025. Furthermore, as an earlier release, the values are subject to revision by subsequent reports, in line with the task's instruction that the most recent report shall prevail.

A methodology change notice indicates a target universe update effective January 2023, which is relevant for data consistency across reports. However, the data series ends in November 2022, failing to cover the full 2022/08–2025/05 period required to determine the average growth rate independently.
